messages:
Devon (Support): P1 -> Arcadian Health. Spikes in inference errors after SAML rollout. Seen: 18% 5xxs, 23% latency > 2s across hosted clusters. Ticket SUP-8421.

Maria (CS Manager): Thanks for flagging. @Kyla can you triage with logs? Need quick comms plan for the account — they go live Tue.

Kyla (CSE): On it. Reproducing now. Shared logs show auth failures: `401` on token exchange and `kv cache miss` before the error cascade. Pasting sample:

```
2026-07-15T12:06:23Z [req=abcd] SAML assertion accepted
2026-07-15T12:06:23Z [req=abcd] token-exchange failed status=401 body="invalid_grant"
2026-07-15T12:06:24Z [req=abcd] inference err code=INFER_TIMEOUT reason="kv-cache-miss"
```

Kyla (CSE): Hypothesis: SAML config changed causing retries leading to cache misses and increased latency. Will test fallback route.

Devon (Support): Customer impact: 12 affected hosts, several production jobs timed out. AE Harper is on call with the customer and wants a one-hour SLA to update them.

Harper (AE): Confirmed. Customer is nervous — their SSO vendor logged errors too. We need a short comms template for the status page and an after-action note. cc @Maria.

Maria (CS Manager): Comms plan:
- 12:30 PT: brief to customer (Harper) — status + mitigation steps
- 13:00 PT: temporary rollback of SAML config (Kyla) if tests fail
- 14:00 PT: full postmortem draft

Owners: Triage/rollback = Kyla; Customer updates = Harper; Exec notice = Maria.

Devon (Support): I've set priority P1 and notified eng-runtime. ops-bot: create incident INC-6312.

ops-bot: Incident INC-6312 created. Pager routed to eng-runtime oncall.

Kyla (CSE): Quick patch validated in staging. Rolling config fix to canary (5% traffic) now.

Harper (AE): Sending first update to Arcadian now. Message: "We're aware of SSO-related failures; engineers are deploying a fix, expect update within 60 minutes. --Harper"

Maria (CS Manager): Good. After action items: collect logs, compare SAML assertion timestamps, and add a preflight SSO checklist for onboardings. Also capture renewal risk — mention to RevOps if churn indicator >3.

Devon (Support): Closing loop with SUP-8421 watchers. I'll post final status when canary looks stable.

Kyla (CSE): Canary green at 12:50 PT, error rate down to 1.2%. Rolling to 100%.

Harper (AE): Customer call set for 13:15 PT to confirm. They appreciated the quick fix. :thumbsup: 

Maria (CS Manager): Thanks team. I'll file the postmortem template and schedule a follow-up with Arcadian next week.
